visual.general_description: Two colour photographs (panels A and B) of a scalp lesion seen from behind and the side, a wider view on the left and a closer view on the right.
visual.detailed_description: Both panels show dark, curly hair parted around a thinly haired, tan to yellowish patch on the scalp. The patch is covered by many small raised, rounded, wart-like bumps clustered into a vertical band, and a single larger pink-tan, rounded, pedunculated-looking nodule hangs at the lower end of the band, pointing down toward the ear. A pale ear is visible at the right edge of each panel. Panel A is a wider view against a dark blue-grey background; panel B is a closer view of the same lesion with the hair and ear larger in frame. Each panel carries a printed black label box with a white panel letter at its upper left. No scale, ruler, text or dates are visible.

visual.general_description: Low-power H&E-stained skin section with a folded, thickened surface epidermis above many rounded pale lobules in the dermis.
visual.detailed_description: Whole-figure view of a pink and purple stained skin section. The top edge shows an irregular, undulating surface epidermis of dark purple cells with several peaks and valleys. Beneath it, the dermis contains a number of rounded to oval lobules of pale, bubbly cells (vacuolated cytoplasm) with small dark nuclei, in sizes from small to large, set in pale pink fibrous tissue; several are arranged around a central pale space. The lower left corner shows wavy pink collagen bundles with few cells. Small clear gaps and a few tissue fragments lie at the edges. No scale bar, label, arrow or text is drawn on the image.
